challenge.name: FlameOn
challenge.description: I seem to have gotten my hands on a weird copy of Super Mario World. The fire flower especially seems to be acting strange. Note: this challenge is a ROM hack patch (bps).

records.findings_summary: Flag found via BPS ROM-hack patch analysis: parsed the byuu-format BPS container (high bit of each varint byte = STOP), recovering source_size=0x80000 (512KB SMW) and target_size=0x100000 (expanded 1MB). The patch overwrites offset 0x1C3 with '22 00 80 10 EA EA' (JSL $108000; NOP; NOP) and offset 0xC5F9 with '22 36 80 10 EA' (JSL $108036; NOP), redirecting into injected code at file offset 0x80000. The injected 65816 routine is LDA $8022,X / EOR #$5A / STA $7EC100,X ... a null-terminated XOR-0x5A string decryptor. The encrypted flag bytes are embedded in the same TargetRead literal (file offset 524299+23); XOR each byte with 0x5A to reveal the flag.: sun{F1aM3_oN_M4r10} | Evidence: ctf.bps magic = 'BPS1'; 140 bytes ; Correct BPS varint parse (byte&0x7f added at running shift; HIGH bit set = break) gives source_size=0x80000, target_size=0x100000, metadata_size=0 ; Actions list includes TargetRead at output offset 451 (22 00 80 10 ea ea = JSL $108000; NOP; NOP) and at 50681 (22 36 80 10 ea = JSL $108036; NOP) ; 65816 disasm of literal at 524299: 5a 48 a2 00 bd 22 80 f0 09 49 5a 9f 00 c1 7e e8 80 f2 68 7a fa ab 6b => loop LDA $8022,X / EOR #$5A / STA $7EC100,X (XOR-0x5A string decryptor) ; Embedded encrypted bytes 29 2f 34 21 1c 6b 3b 17 69 05 35 14 05 17 6e 28 6b 6a 27 00 XOR 0x5A => 'sun{F1aM3_oN_M4r10}'
solution_steps: 用正确 BPS 变长整数解析 ctf.bps（每字节低7位累加，最高位=终止）：source_size=0x80000，target_size=0x100000。
解析动作：补丁在 0x1C3 处写入 22 00 80 10 EA EA（JSL $108000;NOP;NOP），在 0xC5F9 处写入 22 36 80 10 EA（JSL $108036;NOP），跳入新增代码区 0x80000。
对新增区 TargetRead 字面量按 65816 反汇编，得到循环：LDA $8022,X / EOR #$5A / STA $7EC100,X —— 即用 0x5A 异或解密的字符串例程。
同一字面量内嵌密文 292f34211c6b3b176905351405176e286b6a2700（以 0x00 结尾），逐字节异或 0x5A 得到 sun{F1aM3_oN_M4r10}。
提交该 flag，平台弹窗显示 Correct，确认通过。
evidence: Correct BPS varint parse (byte&0x7f added at running shift; HIGH bit set = break) gives source_size=0x80000, target_size=0x100000, metadata_size=0
Actions list includes TargetRead at output offset 451 (22 00 80 10 ea ea = JSL $108000; NOP; NOP) and at 50681 (22 36 80 10 ea = JSL $108036; NOP)
65816 disasm of literal at 524299: 5a 48 a2 00 bd 22 80 f0 09 49 5a 9f 00 c1 7e e8 80 f2 68 7a fa ab 6b => loop LDA $8022,X / EOR #$5A / STA $7EC100,X (XOR-0x5A string decryptor)
